newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Aug 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Aug 29.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Thursday:
* President Bill Clinton arrives in Chicago to claim Democratic Party nomination.
* Clinton is still a political enigma.
* Democrats seek women's votes with a focus on their families.
* Angry at Israel, Palestinian President Yasser Arafat calls a general strike.
* Federal Trade Commission and the Justice Department issue rules to ease the formation of networks of doctors.
* Surge of enrollment in New York strains schools.
